design: At fixed compiled states, compare native residual with three isotropic equal-site-norm draws and three shuffled-document residuals rescaled to each site's native error norm. Charts selected before errors. Target distribution is head(state+scale*error_family); approximate distribution head(state+scale*projected_error_family). No observed next-token labels. Matched and wrong-context charts. Each family normalized by its own uncorrected exact KL. Synthetic targets are NOT native predictions.

gates.generic_sufficiency: At both scales, seed-averaged isotropic rank16 KL recovery >=0.60 and matched-minus-wrong recovery >=0.40.
gates.native_specialness: At both scales, native rank16 recovery exceeds BOTH seed-averaged isotropic and shuffled recovery by >=0.10 with paired document-bootstrap lower bound >0.
gates.entropy_dependence: At full scale/native/rank16, low minus high recovery >=.15 with document-bootstrap95 lower bound >0, both bins >=30 sites.
gates.directional_native_alignment: Native-minus-isotropic and native-minus-shuffled rank16 recovery have paired document-bootstrap95 lower bounds >0 at both scales. Separate from original >=.10 specialness gate.

scope: New128 documents exclude1024 discovery,64 original test,128 H252 test. Same cached corpus, not training holdout. Original support256, ranks16/64, scales .1/1, three control seeds unchanged. Ratio of sums across seeds, document bootstrap. Fixed compiled entropy bins <2,[2,4),>=4 nats.
